question: Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one above the other but not necessarily in the same order. B is placed third from the bottom. Only one box is kept between B and C. Only three boxes are kept between A and E. A is placed at any place above E. F is kept immediately below D. How many boxes are kept between G and B?
